nom: Dr. Althea Pore Refresh Grinding Cleansing Balm

avis.texte: I've tried 4 or 5 cleansing balms, but this cleansing balm makes my larger pores way less noticeable - after the very first use. I have a pinkish undertone to my skin, and it isn't as bad after I use this product. I see the positive difference in my skin every time I use it, highly recommend this product - great ingredients!
Skin felt so soft after one use and at the same time of a double cleanse. Worked well with my normal cleanser. Sensitive, oily skin.
Love the formula, has subtle scent, and is gentle on sensitive skin. I actually feel cleansed after using without it irritating my skin. Will be repurchasing after finishing!
